desc: Derive the minimum-cost formula, monotonicity, and next-greater record structure.

Implement and test the O(n log n) query-based two-pointer solution: compute next strictly greater positions, path_sum, binary lifting table, cost(l,r) query, and sliding count; verify on examples and brute-force random small arrays.
Confirm the solution passes the provided examples and random brute-force checks; no fallback approach needed.
